text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: âMan, I wanna eat ramen.

A whisper slipped suddenly from Fine 
Motion's lips. In that instant, a shiver 
ran through the roomâ

Whenever she quietly mutters "ramen," 
something has always happened. For 
instance—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: âMan, I wanna eat ramen.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...No. That's not what I mean.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! Let's arrange for a food 
truck!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I want to create a ramen with my own 
hands that matches this impulse! Right 
now!
Yet another day—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's build a ramen alley right 
here on campus!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go consult the chairwoman! 
I'm counting on your diplomatic skills~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Trainer is okay with heights?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There is a ramen I want to eat right this 
second, but it can only be reached from 
the sky. Let us fly together!

...Even after that, whenever ramen was 
involved, she showed an unimaginable 
passion. Just what will today's order be—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, um, there's this ramen place I've 
been curious about for a while now... 
Would you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
? Yeah. There's a little something I wanna 
try~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There are three types that caught my 
interest. Could you pick which one we 
should tackle?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Your keywords are "Chashu Ramen," "Abura 
Soba," and "Dan Dan Noodles"! Which one do 
you want?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it might surprise you a little, you 
know? I can't wait~!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Order up! Here's the "Sky-Piercing Chashu 
Tower Ramen"!
(Rumble, rumble, rumble...)

What appeared before us was... a bowl of 
shoyu ramen piled so high with roast pork 
it looked ready to touch the sky...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah... The Tower of Babel was completed 
right here on this land, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, fetch the ladder, please! Let us 
challenge it from the very top!
choice_data_list: Are you okay on your own?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Who do you think I am?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I shall finish every last bite. Upon my 
family's name...!"

And so, Fine Motion ate her way down from 
the top of the chashu tower, and then—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for the meal♪ Phew... Master, 
that was truly delicious!

She brilliantly knocked down the tower all 
by herself...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...! You're going there, aren't you? To 
that realm, at long last...!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Order up! Here's the "Garlic Swamped Abura 
Soba"!

Suddenly, a blizzard-like gust of intense 
garlic smell enveloped the area...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Th-This is...!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness, this is far too 
dangerous...! This is no longer ramen, 
it's just a mountain of chopped garlic...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, I cannot run away. No matter what form 
it takes, so long as it bears the name of 
ramen—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let us shower it with love! Thanks for the 
food!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ――YAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!! Phew... One more rep!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...They sure look intensely motivated. 
Wait, huh? Aren't they hanging a weird 
sign?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Please do not come within a 1km radius. 
Fine"...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!? Shakur!? N-No! I told you not to 
come over~! Meanies!"

...That day, we were treated to the rare 
sight of Air Shakur chasing after Fine 
Motion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Are you really sure?! No matter what 
happens to me...?!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Order up! Here's the "Agonizingly 
Mind-Blowing Super Spicy Dandan Noodles"!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Commonly known as "Menkibu"... Its 
defining feature is that the soup turns 
pale blue from the sheer spiciness.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Please protect me. Down the hatch...!
(WHOOOOOSH...!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Am I... running? Rounding the fourth 
corner, into the final stretch—
(Dadadadadadadada...!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
! It's coming...! "That thing" is 
approaching at incredible speed...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I-It's so spiiiiiiicy--!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Ow. Yeth, I'm fyne, yeah... *groan*

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh, it's painful, so painful, but... 
I feel like I've grasped something...!"

—Just as promised, she showed off a truly 
sensational run during training the very 
next day.
